info.title: opencode HttpApi
info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.

get.description: Return the server identity, connection URLs, paths, and readiness status.

post.description: Create a short-lived, single-use code for a /auth/connect/:code pairing link.

get.description: Redeem a pairing code. Browsers receive a session cookie and a redirect to the web app; requests that accept JSON receive a session token to use as the password.
Resolve the requested location or the server default location.

post.description: Shut down and rebuild every loaded location. Pending permissions and forms are cancelled; running sessions continue with fresh services at the next step boundary. Emits location.shutdown for client recovery and responds once all replacement builds settle.

get.description: Retrieve currently registered agents.
Retrieve a single currently registered agent.
Retrieve enabled server plugins and their current status.

post.description: Check one or all package plugins for available updates.
Update package plugins concurrently and notify active locations to reload them. Responds once every update has finished; fails when any update fails.

schema.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Filter by parent session. Use null to return only root sessions.

schema.description: When true, list archived sessions instead of active sessions.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

get.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location. A parentID creates a linked child session at its parent's location.

get.description: Aggregate local session activity, usage, and tool reliability for a time range.

post.description: Import a projected session transcript at the requested location. If parentID is supplied, the parent session must already exist; import parents before children.

get.description: Export a complete projected session transcript.
Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this Opencode++ process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.
Retrieve a session by ID.

delete.description: Delete a session and its child sessions. A project's main orchestrator session cannot be deleted while its project exists.

post.description: Create a child session by copying projected history before a message. Omit before to copy the full history.
Switch the agent used by subsequent provider turns.
Switch the model used by subsequent provider turns.
Move a session to another project directory at the requested delivery boundary.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
Execute a slash command callback immediately.
Activate a skill for a session by appending a skill message and resuming execution.
Durably admit synthetic session input and schedule execution unless resume is false.
Execute one shell command in the session's working directory. Emits a shell.started event before execution and a shell.ended event with the merged output after.
Durably admit a session compaction request. Steers by default: it runs at the next step boundary instead of waiting behind queued prompts.
Wait for a session agent loop to become idle.
Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).

schema.description: User message whose turn to diff. Defaults to the turn of the newest user message.
Later user message whose turn ends the range. Defaults to the turn of `from` alone.
Unchanged lines around each hunk. Omit for full-file patches.

get.description: Structured per-file diffs of the files a turn changed. A turn runs from the first prompt after the session was last idle until its next idle marker, so prompts steered in while it was busy belong to the same turn; `to` extends the range through a later turn. Compares the range's first recorded snapshot with its last; a step still running in the active session compares against the working copy. Ranges that span a location change are rejected. In sessions without any idle marker, a prompt's turn spans until the next user message.
List durable enqueued session work not yet delivered, ordered by enqueue sequence. Includes user, synthetic, compaction, and move items.

delete.description: Cancel an inbox item that has not yet been delivered. Unavailable items are a no-op.

patch.description: Change a pending inbox item's delivery mode. Steering wakes session execution.

get.description: List API-managed instruction entries attached to the session.

put.description: Attach or replace one durable instruction entry. Changes announce as updates at the next step boundary.

delete.description: Remove one instruction entry; the removal is announced to the model at the next step boundary.

post.description: Generate transient text from the current session context without mutating session history.

get.description: Experimental durable session event log. Reads events after an exclusive aggregate sequence and continues with live events when follow=true.

post.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this Opencode++ process. Returns interrupted=true when an active execution was interrupted and false for the idle no-op. When resume=true, execution resumes pending steering input and next-in-line control items (manual compaction, moves) while queued prompts remain parked.
Move active foreground backgroundable tools for this session into background observation. Idle requests are a no-op.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.
Retrieve pending forms for a session.

post.description: Create a form for a session.

get.description: Retrieve a form and its current state for a session.

delete.description: Cancel a pending form, optionally telling the asker why it was not answered.

post.description: Submit an answer to a pending form.

put.description: Replace the process environment used by local shell commands for this session.

post.description: Mark the idle transition observed by the viewer as viewed.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.

schema.description: Filter by message type before pagination. When omitted, all message types are returned. Pass the same type when following cursors.

get.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session, optionally filtered by type. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline, passing the same type filter on each page.
Retrieve the current snapshot of available models ordered by release date. The snapshot may precede initial plugin settlement.
Retrieve the model used when a session has no explicit model selection.

post.description: Run one stateless model generation using the server's base configuration and return the assistant text. Uses the base configuration's default model when none is specified.

get.description: Retrieve active AI providers so clients can show provider availability and configuration.
Retrieve a single AI provider so clients can inspect its availability and endpoint settings.
Retrieve available integrations and their authentication methods.
Retrieve one integration and its authentication methods.

post.description: Discover and persist an experimental wellknown integration source.
Run a key authentication method and store the resulting credential.
Run an external authentication method and store a reference to its credential source.
Start an OAuth attempt and return the authorization details.

get.description: Poll the current status of an OAuth attempt.

delete.description: Cancel an OAuth attempt and release its resources.

post.description: Complete a code-based OAuth attempt and store the resulting credential.
Start a command authentication attempt.

get.description: Poll the current status and output of a command authentication attempt.

delete.description: Cancel a command authentication attempt and terminate its process.

get.description: Retrieve configured MCP servers and their connection status.

put.description: Add an MCP server at runtime or replace an existing one, connecting it immediately.

delete.description: Stop an MCP server and remove it from the runtime set until restart.

post.description: Connect an MCP server at runtime, overriding a disabled configuration until restart.
Disconnect an MCP server at runtime, removing its tools until reconnected.

get.description: Retrieve resources and resource templates from connected MCP servers.
List every stored integration credential, including its secret value.

post.description: Store an integration credential. It becomes the integration's active credential unless activate is false and the integration already has one. Fails with a conflict when the requested ID already exists.

delete.description: Remove a stored integration credential.

post.description: Activate a stored integration credential.

get.description: List known projects.

patch.description: Update the project canonical directory, display metadata, and workspace commands.

get.description: Retrieve pending forms for a location.
Retrieve pending permission requests for a location.
Retrieve saved permissions, optionally filtered by project.

delete.description: Remove a saved permission by ID.

post.description: Evaluate and, when approval is required, create a permission request for a session.

get.description: Retrieve pending permission requests owned by a session.
Retrieve a pending permission request owned by a session.

post.description: Respond to a pending permission request owned by a session.

get.description: Stream one file relative to the requested location with ETag, Last-Modified, and single-range HTTP Range support (206 Partial Content, 416 Range Not Satisfiable, and 304 Not Modified; multi-range and malformed Range headers fall back to 200).

schema.description: An absolute path or a path relative to the requested location. Defaults to the location directory.

get.description: List direct children using an absolute path or a path relative to the requested location, including parents and siblings outside its directory. Entry paths remain relative to the requested location; listing does not switch locations.
Find recursively ranked filesystem entries relative to the requested location.

schema.description: An absolute path or a path relative to the requested location. Missing parent directories are created.

post.description: Write the raw request body to an absolute path or a path relative to the requested location, creating parent directories, and return the resolved absolute path. Unlike read, the target is not confined to the location. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.

get.description: Retrieve currently registered commands.
Retrieve currently registered skills.

post.description: Dispatch a method to the currently registered RPC at the requested location.

get.description: Subscribe to native events and plugin RPC events across all server locations. Volatile by contract: a slow consumer overflows and fails the stream, and events during disconnection are missed.
List PTY sessions for a location, including exited sessions retained until removal.

post.description: Create a pseudo-terminal session for a location.

get.description: Get one PTY session, including its exit code once exited.

put.description: Update the title or viewport size of one PTY session.

delete.description: Terminate and remove one PTY session.

post.description: Create a short-lived single-use ticket for opening a PTY WebSocket connection.

get.description: Establish a WebSocket connection streaming PTY output and accepting terminal input.

Read the last physical rows without changing selection or taking control. Omitted lines uses the live terminal height; larger counts include retained history. Blank rows are preserved. Screen dimensions and cursor remain relative to the live screen. Returns null when no current terminal exists. Selection is server-local and resets on restart. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.
get.summary: Read the session's most recently controlled terminal

get.description: Stream persistent PTY output through the Opencode++ server.
List currently running shell commands for a location. Exited commands are not included.

post.description: Spawn one non-interactive shell command for a location. Combined stdout/stderr is captured to a file pageable via output.

get.description: Get one shell command, including its status and exit code once exited.

delete.description: Terminate and remove one shell command and its retained output.

get.description: Page through captured combined output by absolute byte cursor.
List references available in the requested location.
Return the project's saved worktree inventory without loading configuration or running discovery.

post.description: Load the project's canonical configuration, create a local worktree using its selected strategy, then run the project's setup script.

delete.description: Load the project's canonical configuration and remove a saved worktree using its recorded strategy.

post.description: Load the project's canonical configuration, discover worktrees across known checkout roots using all available strategies, and reconcile saved state.

Initialize a repository using the selected VCS provider in a markerless project's directory and refresh its location services. Omitting provider defaults to git; built-in git and hg providers support initialization. An unknown provider returns 400; a registered provider without init returns 501.

get.description: Get current and default branch information for the requested location.

Infer a local review base from named branch creation history, or the repository default only when currently on that branch. Returns null before the first commit or when the provider lacks base metadata; ambiguous Git history requires an explicit base on diff requests.
List uncommitted working-copy changes relative to the requested location.
List local and remote branches available at the requested location.

Diff HEAD to the working copy (working), the base merge-base to the working copy (branch), or the base merge-base to HEAD (committed). Omitting base preserves repository-default comparison; supplying it overrides the comparison without saving it.
Every note in .opencode/notes of the requested location, most recently updated first.

post.description: Create a note. Without a name, one is derived from the title (Cyrillic is transliterated). A taken name gets a numeric suffix.

name.description: Note file name without .md: 2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens

schema.description: Note file name without .md: 2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens

get.description: Read one note with its frontmatter, body and the mtime later writes must echo back.

schema.description: Note file name without .md: 2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens

patch.description: Change the title, status, tags or length of a note without touching its body.

schema.description: Note file name without .md: 2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens

delete.description: Delete the note file.

get.description: The note whose frontmatter binds it to the session, the most recently updated one when several do, or null.
get.summary: Get the note bound to a session

schema.description: Note file name without .md: 2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens

post.description: Replace the body of a note, or append to it, keeping its frontmatter.

schema.description: Note file name without .md: 2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens

post.description: Bind the note to a session, so the agent of that session writes into it; omit session to unbind it.

get.description: List locations currently loaded by the server.

delete.description: Dispose the requested location's cached services so its next use boots them fresh.

get.description: Return the progress of the V1 to V2 session history migration.
Return the registered web search providers.

post.description: Run one web search through the selected provider. Specify a provider to override the configured default.

get.description: Return configuration documents and discovery sources for the requested location, from lowest to highest priority.
Return shells available to terminal and agent execution.

patch.description: Patch supported fields in the highest-precedence global configuration document.

get.description: Report every ecosystem (.claude, .codex, .gemini, ...) found for the requested location, whether it is on, and whether it is trusted.

post.description: Store the user's per-project choice outside the repository. The choice outranks config; trust lets project folders run code or loosen permissions.
post.summary: Choose or trust an ecosystem for this project

get.description: List the rooms this host shares with other devices.

post.description: Share a session as a room that other devices can join with a code.

patch.description: Rename a room, set the host nickname, or change what guests and the host model may do in it.

delete.description: Stop sharing a room. Its session stays; every guest token for it stops working.

get.description: The items of the shared project's Definition of Done, with the guests who took them.

post.description: Give a guest's DoD item back to the room, for a guest who left or stopped working on it.
post.summary: Free a DoD item a guest took

get.description: What happened in the room after a seq: joins and leaves, DoD items taken, given back, expired, passed or failed, and commands run. With wait, an empty answer waits that many milliseconds for the next event.

post.description: Create a short-lived code that lets devices join this room until it expires.

get.description: Names of the rooms this host shares, for devices looking for rooms on the network, and whether each one lets guests in without a code. A closed room is listed without its name.

post.description: Redeem a join code, or name an open room, for a guest token scoped to one room.

get.description: Return the room, the calling guest and the shared session.

delete.description: Stop being a member of the room; the guest's token stops working and the host no longer lists it.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.

schema.description: Filter by message type before pagination. When omitted, all message types are returned. Pass the same type when following cursors.

get.description: The shared session's full messages, tool calls included, paged like the session message list, so guests see the session as the host does.
Rooms on other computers this computer joined, which its AI can work with.

put.description: Keep a room this computer joined, with its guest token, so this computer's AI can reach it.

post.description: Forget a room this computer left; its AI no longer reaches it.

get.description: The host's system, shells, Registry tools, the shared project's git state and the plots teams hold there.

post.description: Run one command in a room session's directory with the host's shell, once the host allows it; cohosts only.
post.summary: Run a command on the host's computer

get.description: The items of the host project's Definition of Done, with who took each one.

post.description: Take a free item of the host project's DoD for the calling guest, or the first ready one with next, optionally holding a plot over the paths it changes, or give back one the guest took; members and above. An item waiting for unfinished items cannot be taken, and one whose holder's lease ran out can. A take answers with the item's handover note.
post.summary: Take or give back a DoD item

post.description: The host runs the item's verification.command in its project and records the result: exit code 0 makes the item DONE with its evidence, anything else FAILED. Only the guest holding the item submits it.
post.summary: Submit a DoD item for the host's check

get.description: What happened in the room after a seq. With wait, an empty answer waits that many milliseconds for the next event.
The sessions a guest may open: every top-level session of a project room, or the shared one.

post.description: Start a new session in a project room's directory. Viewers may not.
post.summary: Start a session in the room

get.description: The models the host can run in this room's sessions.
The agents the host can run in this room's sessions.
The MCP servers the host's model can use in this room's sessions, with their state.
The commands a cohost may run in this room's sessions.

post.description: Switch the model of one of the room's sessions; cohosts only.
Switch the agent of one of the room's sessions; cohosts only.
Run one of the host's commands, such as compact, in one of the room's sessions; cohosts only.
post.summary: Run a command in a room session

get.description: The guests admitted to a room, their roles and whether they are connected now.

patch.description: Let a guest only watch, also write, or also answer the model's permission requests.

delete.description: Revoke a guest's token; the guest may join again with a code or an open room.

post.description: Remove a guest and keep its device and address out of this room.

get.description: Guests kept out of this room.

delete.description: Let a banned guest join this room again.

get.description: The shared session's durable event log, continuing with live events when follow=true.
The latest messages of the shared session as plain chat, whether the host model is working, and the note the session writes into, if any.
The note bound to the shared session, which prompts in this room write into, or null when none is bound.

post.description: Post a message into the shared session as the calling guest; the host model answers. Viewers may not post.
post.summary: Send a message to the room

get.description: Pending permission requests of the shared session.

post.description: Answer the host model's permission request; allowed only to guests with the helper role.

get.description: Read this device's view of its replicated Mesh room, elected coordinator and quorum health.

post.description: Create a forming Mesh and return its enrollment secret for the other devices.

get.description: Return the existing Mesh invitation token only to the original owner so it can invite additional learner devices after activation.
get.summary: Read the owner's Mesh invitation token

post.description: Join a forming Mesh through a reachable seed device and its enrollment secret.
post.summary: Enroll this device in a Mesh

post.description: Forget the Mesh state stored on this device so it can join another room. Remaining peers keep their current fixed membership.
post.summary: Disconnect this device from its local Mesh

post.description: Prepare the same voter set on all enrolled devices before starting coordinator elections.
Propose a message or task; the event is accepted only after majority commit.

get.description: Read committed room events from a cursor. Uncommitted entries are not exposed.

post.description: Internal peer transport for enrollment, elections and log replication. Requires the Mesh bearer secret.

get.description: List the projects the operator created, oldest first.

post.description: Create a named project for an existing directory; its sessions are those opened in or below it. With a template, also open the main session and one session per team member. With an isolation, the directory must be a git repository and the project becomes a sandbox in a new detached worktree of it.

get.description: Ready-made AI teams a project can be created with: the role sessions each one opens.

post.description: Add the operator's own team: a name and the role sessions it opens.

put.description: Replace a team template, built-in or the operator's own.

delete.description: Delete the operator's own team template, or restore a built-in one to its default.

get.description: The roles team sessions run: built-in ones with the operator's edits, then the operator's own.

post.description: Add the operator's own role; its sessions run the team-<id> agent with the role's rules.

put.description: Replace a role, built-in or the operator's own.

delete.description: Delete the operator's own role, unless a team template still uses it, or restore a built-in one to its default.

patch.description: Rename a project or point it at another directory.

delete.description: Forget a project. Its sessions, including its main session, are kept.

post.description: Return the project's main session, creating it in the project directory on first use.

get.description: Recent top-level sessions in the project directory, the main session's access to each and the categories they are grouped under.
The project that opened each session a project opened, by session ID. Other sessions belong to the deepest project containing their directory.

put.description: Keep a session with the project that opened it, even when other projects share its directory.
Set what the project's main session may do with this session.
Group a project session under a category; an empty category removes it.

get.description: Named sets of projects the operator keeps together.

put.description: Create a group of projects or replace the one with the same name.

delete.description: Delete a group. The projects and their links stay.

post.description: Link every pair of projects in the group so each knows the others and may ask them questions.

Create the group's own chat, or return the one it already has. The chat lives in the group's directory, outside every member project's tree. The mode is the group's saved one; it is changed in the group dialog, not here.
Tie two projects together so each knows the other and may ask it questions, or undo it.

get.description: The projects linked to this one.

model.description: Default model for new sessions, as provider/model

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to add or replace under mcp.servers by name; null removes one

compatibilityEnabled.description: Turn reading other agent tools' folders on or off everywhere (compatibility.enabled); null clears it

anyOf.description: Reuse a randomly selected provider until it is rate limited, then switch to another available provider.

value.description: JSON value attached to the session's instructions

Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

Note.Slug.description: Note file name without extension (2 to 60 lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter)

Note.Tag.description: Note tag (1 to 32 lowercase latin alphanumerics and hyphens, starting with an alphanumeric)

start.description: Startup script to run when creating a new workspace (worktree)

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this Opencode++ process was interrupted.

started.description: Start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

tags.name: note
tags.description: Location-scoped notes in .opencode/notes. Every write and removal emits a note.updated event on the event stream.

tags.name: orchestra
tags.description: Operator projects and their main sessions.
